info.title: ChineseLearn
info.description: Backend API for Chinese language learning app

get.description:
List vocabulary words with optional filters.

Query params:
- hsk_level: HSK1 | HSK2 | HSK3 | HSK4 | HSK5 | HSK6
- search: full-text search across simplified, pinyin, definitions
- skip / limit: pagination

Return words whose next_review is <= now (due for SRS review).
New words (no progress entry yet) are included up to the limit.

schema.title: Response Get Due Reviews Api V1 Vocabulary Review Get

post.description:
Submit a flashcard review result.
quality: 0-5 (SM-2 scale: 0=blackout, 3=correct w/ difficulty, 5=perfect)

get.description: Return aggregate SRS progress per HSK level.

Stream a local MP3 audio file.
Example: GET /api/v1/audio/hsk1/谢谢.mp3  (or 行_xing2.mp3 for a specific reading)

If the file doesn't exist, return 404.
The frontend should fall back to browser-side Google TTS for missing files.
